articles.title: India's richest state is exploring tokenizing its own assets to fund new infrastructure
articles.snippet: Maharashtra is drafting a policy to tokenize the state's assets, including the electricity transmission infrastructure.

articles.title: Europe’s top regulator questions Polymarket and Kalshi’s EU access, warns of authorization gaps
articles.snippet: ESMA said that event contracts may fall under existing EU binary-options bans, crypto-asset frameworks like MiCA or national gambling laws.

articles.title: Polymarket names former Amazon finance chief Warren Jenson as its first CFO
articles.snippet: Jenson becomes the prediction market’s first CFO as Polymarket builds its regulated U.S. exchange and global platform.

articles.title: EU Regulator Says Prediction Markets Are 'Rife With Inside Trading'
articles.snippet: ESMA also asks why Kalshi and Polymarket block some EU countries but not others, and notes VPNs get around the blocks.

articles.title: Prediction Markets Abandon Cheap Oil as Brent Passes $100
articles.snippet: Myriad's $120 side overtook $55 at the start of September, while Polymarket puts WTI reaching $100 this month at 59%.
